Kaomoji Generator

Browse a big categorized bank of kaomoji faces — click any face to copy it instantly.

Click any face to copy it.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a category tab.
  2. Browse the faces.
  3. Click one to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which categories are included?

Happy, Sad, Love, Angry and Surprised — 15 or more faces in each, 90+ total.

How do I copy a face?

Click any kaomoji to copy it to your clipboard, then paste it anywhere.

How are kaomoji different from emoji?

Kaomoji are text faces typed with keyboard characters, like (^_^). They work anywhere plain text works, with no special font needed.
